# contextforge_server (Resource)

Manages a ContextForge virtual server resource



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Server name

### Optional

- `associated_a2a_agents` (List of String) List of associated A2A agent IDs
- `associated_prompts` (List of String) List of associated prompt IDs
- `associated_resources` (List of String) List of associated resource IDs
- `associated_tools` (List of String) List of associated tool IDs
- `description` (String) Server description
- `icon` (String) Server icon (URL or data URI)
- `tags` (List of String) Server tags
- `team_id` (String) Team ID
- `visibility` (String) Server visibility setting

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp (RFC3339)
- `created_by` (String) User who created the server
- `created_from_ip` (String) IP address of creator
- `created_user_agent` (String) User agent of creator
- `created_via` (String) Creation method
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the server is enabled
- `federation_source` (String) Federation source
- `id` (String) Server unique identifier
- `import_batch_id` (String) Import batch identifier
- `is_active` (Boolean) Whether the server is active
- `metrics` (Attributes) Server execution metrics (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--metrics))
- `modified_by` (String) User who last modified the server
- `modified_from_ip` (String) IP address of modifier
- `modified_user_agent` (String) User agent of modifier
- `modified_via` (String) Modification method
- `oauth_config` (Dynamic, Sensitive) OAuth configuration metadata
- `oauth_enabled` (Boolean) Whether OAuth is enabled for this server
- `owner_email` (String) Owner email address
- `team` (String) Team name (read-only)
- `updated_at` (String) Last update timestamp (RFC3339)
- `version` (Number) Server version number
